measured_contract.requirement_id: mandatory - an acceptance may only be resolved through its own requirement
measured_contract.evidence_ref: must already exist in evidence_refs (no orphan verdicts)
measured_contract.lease: required on acceptance_id, held by actor (spine.py:536 _assert_lease)
measured_contract.expected_version: must equal the live version (0 while NOT_RUN)
measured_contract.idempotency_key: a replay returns the original event only when it names this same acceptance
measured_contract.transaction: state change and canonical event in one transaction; prior verdict kept as from_state
measured_contract.disclosed_limitation: evidence_refs has no subject column, so the claim is registered-evidence-binding, not subject-bound-evidence

rows.oracle: VERIFY_SECURITY lane receipt + verifier JSON (required arm glm-5.3-flash, ok=true, CLEAN window)
VERIFY_SECURITY lane receipt (rank3 glm-5.3-flash) + CI conclusions on merged main

precedent_in_live_db.interpretation: the oracle field, not the verdict enum, is where the independent-lane provenance lives. With the current enum an equivalent transition must be recorded as PASS with the lane receipt named in oracle and evidence_ref.

draft_payload.acceptance_id: <created by register_requirement for the W0 acceptance>
draft_payload.actor: <the officer identity that judged - NOT the maker>
draft_payload.requirement_id: <the W0 requirement this acceptance belongs to>

payload.oracle: VERIFY_SECURITY lane receipt (codex-cli 0.164.0, model gpt-6.1-sol, sandbox read-only, fresh session) + officer verdict JSON
payload.separation_claim: process/lane/model separation; principal separation NOT established on a single-account host

blocking_gap: the transition needs a lease held by the officer identity. The officer runs read-only and cannot take one; the maker taking it on the officer's behalf would collapse the separation it is supposed to prove. Only the owner can issue or act under that identity.
